senses.gloss:
tithinirṇaya
(‘choosing the day [according to the lunar चलेन्दर्]’)
------------------------------------------
Treatises dealing with the imparting of mantras, like the Mantrayogasaṁhitā, have specified which days of the lunar चलेन्दर् (called tithis) are suitable for it and which are not.
The following days are auspicious: dvitīya (second day); tṛtīyā (third day); pañcamī (fifth day); saptamī (seventh day); daśamī (tenth day); एकादशी (eleventh day); द्वादशी (twelfth day); pūrṇimā (full-मोओन् day).
The other days, including अमावास्या (new-मोओन् day), are considered inauspicious.
